name: OBHB
recent: OB Holdings 于2026年11月19日召开第三届年度股东大会，所有决议均获通过，包括董事薪酬、连任董事及续聘核数师。公司于10月30日公布2027财年首季业绩，净利同比增长20.99%至196万令吉，但营收同比下滑9.0%。此外，公司近期出现董事局及委员会成员变动，并有一项重大诉讼公告。
notable: 第三届年度股东大会于2026年11月19日举行，所有决议均获股东通过。
2027财年首季净利同比增长20.99%至196万令吉，但营收同比下滑9.0%。
董事局及多个委员会出现成员变动，包括Dato' Haji Mohd Dusuki Bin Ya'acob退任董事。
risks: 公司于2026年11月16日公告一项重大诉讼。
earnings: 2027财年首季（截至2026年8月31日）营收为1449.2万令吉，环比下降21.2%，同比下降9.0%；净利为196万令吉，环比下降21.6%，但同比增长14.1%。净利率为13.5%，与上季的13.6%基本持平。

recent_en: OB Holdings held its 3rd AGM on 19 Nov 2026, where all resolutions including directors' fees, re-election of directors and re-appointment of auditors were passed. The company reported 1Q FY2027 net profit up 20.99% YoY to RM1.96 million on 30 Oct, despite a 9.0% YoY decline in revenue. There were also board and committee changes, and a material litigation announcement.
notable_en: The 3rd AGM was held on 19 Nov 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
1Q FY2027 net profit rose 20.99% YoY to RM1.96 million, while revenue declined 9.0% YoY.
There were changes in the board and several committees, including the retirement of Dato' Haji Mohd Dusuki Bin Ya'acob as Director.
risks_en: The company announced a material litigation on 16 Nov 2026.
Director Miss Lee Bao Yu reported dealings in the company's shares on 29 Sep 2026 (acquired 10,000 shares, after disposing 30,000 shares on 30 Mar 2026).
earnings_en: For 1Q FY2027 (ended 31 Aug 2026), revenue was RM14.492 million, down 21.2% QoQ and 9.0% YoY; net profit was RM1.96 million, down 21.6% QoQ but up 14.1% YoY. Net margin was 13.5%, roughly flat versus 13.6% in the previous quarter.
